description: Inverts or scales a polyphonic signal under manual and voltage control, reaching twice the input level at the extremes, with a polarity CV per channel

params.text: Sets how much of the polarity CV is applied; at full, 5V gives unity gain and 10V gives twice the input level
Sets the polarity by hand, -2 to +2 — silence in the middle, inversion below it, twice the input level at either extreme. Applied to every channel and summed with that channel's CV

inputs.text: Controls the polarity, scaled by the CV amount knob and summed with POLARITY; a negative voltage inverts. A monophonic cable here is applied to every input channel
The signal to be polarized; the number of channels patched here sets the number of channels at the output

outputs.text: Carries the input multiplied by the polarity, clamped to 10V either way

notes: the sixteen STATUS lamps show the polarity reaching each channel rather than its signal level, red for inversion and green for positive
